about_the_game:
GRIBOUILLE

GRIBOUILLE is a poetic adventure where you explore a world made of children’s drawings brought to life. Behind its naïve and fragile appearance, the game offers a unique platforming experience, at the crossroads between a sketchbook and an interactive museum.

You play as a small character traveling through scattered pages. Each page you collect is not just a memory: it becomes a checkpoint, a step in your journey, and a fragment of a shattered notebook you must piece back together.

Key Features:

  • A poetic and accessible platformer: explore, jump, and discover a hand-drawn universe.

  • Collection and progression: every page you find is both a collectible and a save point, turning discovery into true progression.

  • A unique visual universe: 300 original hand-made drawings come to life in a world blending childlike sketches with artistic installation.

  • A contemplative experience: GRIBOUILLE is not just a video game, it’s also an exhibition. Each level feels like a gallery where drawings animate before your eyes.

  • A rich and extended adventure: the game offers generous content, designed to provide long hours of discovery and exploration, filled with platforms, secrets, and pages to uncover.

  • Immersive soundscape: a soft and experimental soundtrack accompanies your journey, enhancing the atmosphere between dream and reality.

In short

GRIBOUILLE is both playful and contemplative. It’s a game for those who love exploring singular worlds, discovering personal universes, and being surprised by the poetry of drawing.
More than entertainment, it offers an artistic stroll where every player writes their own reading of the notebook.
